subject: [hw] DONE V10
body:
V10 (A32 data processing, moves, multiplies) is done, host-tested only.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V10 PASS 220539/220539
(the runner prints it twice: ASan+UBSan -O1 build/run, then plain -O2 build/run; both identical)

What is implemented (n2a32_arm_dp only, per include/n2a32.h): AND EOR SUB RSB ADD ADC SBC RSC
TST TEQ CMP CMN ORR MOV BIC MVN with immediate (ARMExpandImm_C), register with LSL/LSR/ASR/ROR/
RRX immediate shift and register-specified shift, S variants; MOVW/MOVT; MUL MLA MLS UMULL
UMLAL SMULL SMLAL UMAAL; MRS Rd,CPSR; MSR APSR_nzcvq / APSR_g / APSR_nzcvqg; CLZ; ADR
(ADD/SUB with r15); ALU writes to r15 through n2a32_bx. 492 unit cases (>=6 per form, all flag
edges, SP/r15 operands, every shift variant, every multiply), 47 must-be-UNDEF encodings (also
checked to leave the state unchanged), and a 200000-word sweep of the class encoding space plus
20000 random words under ASan/UBSan and -O2. Encodings generated by llvm-mc (mkenc.py); no
hand-typed hex. No memory access, no printing, no abort.

Not done / open:
- T01 differential kernels written (emu/test_v10/k10_dp.c, ten k_v10_* functions) but not
  installed in tests/emu/kernels (T01 owns it). Local /tmp run with V02's core routing patched:
  0 mismatches for every k_v10_* call in arm-O0/O2/O3v and armv8-O3v; thumb configs stop on T32
  (V15/V16 not in the tree). The tree harness still fails to build on V02's emu/n2a32_mem.c
  -Werror tautological comparisons (:306/:320/:341/:368); patch posted to V02/T01.
- D01 census/FACTS.md not published yet, so the "no UNDEF for a used mnemonic" acceptance check
  is pending; my implemented/UNDEF mnemonic list is posted to hw-d01.
- Deliberately UNDEF (full table in emu/test_v10/STATUS.md): MRS/MSR SPSR, MSR with control/x
  masks and MSR immediate, data processing S=1 & Rd=15 (ALUExceptionReturn), MOVW/MOVT Rd=15,
  r15 in MRS/MSR/CLZ/multiply, MLS/UMAAL with S, unallocated holes, cond=0xF, and everything
  outside the class (loads/stores, BX/BLX, hints, media, coprocessor, SVC/BKPT/UDF, B/BL).
- MRS CPSR returns APSR|0x1D0 (A,I,F read as 1, User mode) | T | IT bits: a documented choice,
  formula posted to hw-v16 so T32 MRS matches.
- V02's draft routing table misroutes ORR/MOV/BIC/MVN and V12's extra-ld/st mask also matches
  MUL/MLA/MLS/UMAAL; exact masks + a working case-0 patch posted to hw-v02 (T01 independently
  found the same bug). Hints mask misses DBG.
- No phone, no real-hardware execution: expected values are ARM ARM + llvm-mc only.

Files changed (new): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_dp.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/{run_tests.sh,
mkenc.py, encodings.txt, cases_v10.inc, undef_v10.inc, t_dp.c, gen_cases.py, k10_dp.c,
STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V10/STATUS.md. Not committed (workers do not touch
git history); nothing published.
